outcomes.title: What your child gets, and who they become
outcomes.sub: Six things a child takes away from growing up on this campus.

items.how: A dorm in-charge looks after every dormitory, meals are planned by a dietician, and a trained nurse is on campus around the clock.
Academic advisors set goals and track progress with every student, and NEET, JEE, CET, NATA and CA coaching runs alongside the Jr. College timetable.
Five daily prayers in the prayer hall, Qur’an recitation and basic Islamic education, with a Hifz course available on request.
Cricket, football, hockey, archery, horse riding, skating and a shooting range, on the largest sports ground in town.

items.promise: Ready for the world they will work in
items.how: A robotics and AI tinkering lab, a computer lab, and Basic Aviation and Agriculture courses added in 2024.
Peer tutors, resident advisors and inter-house contests in dramatics, debate, football and more build teamwork and lasting friendships.

school_story.title: From thirty students in 1920 to a hundred years of trust
school_story.sub: The Panchgani school began with the aim of building a school on the model of Harrow and Eton.

items.text: Mr. Hoonseinbhoy Laljee and others form the Darul-Uloom Trust. Darul-Uloom Muslim High School opens in Panchgani, in a bungalow lent by the Nawab of Wai, with thirty students.
The school moves to an estate of over 168 acres on the Panchgani–Mahabaleshwar road.
The trust passes to Anjuman-I-Islam. Under President Mr. Akbar Peerbhoy and Mrs. Homai Peerbhoy the school grows into a premier seat of learning for boys and girls.
The school completes 100 years of education, with former students leading across the globe.
Robotics, Agriculture and Basic Aviation join horse riding, pottery and archery on campus.

heritage.h1: A century of shaping confident, capable young people
heritage.lead: Your child lives, learns and grows on 174 acres of the Panchgani hills, with strong academics, Qur’anic values and a family of teachers around them. Part of Anjuman-I-Islam, serving education since 1874.

hillstation.lead: A residential school and junior college across 174 acres of hill country, where children grow in confidence, faith and skill. Part of Anjuman-I-Islam, serving education since 1874.

modern.h1: Learn beyond the classroom. Grow beyond limits.
modern.lead: A residential school on 174 acres in the hills of Panchgani. Robotics, aviation, agriculture and NEET / JEE coaching, with a dorm family that looks after your child, grounded in a century of values.

vibrant.h1: Where your child grows up curious, confident and cared for
vibrant.lead: Robotics, riding, archery and friends for life on 174 acres in the Panchgani hills, with teachers and a dorm family looking after every child.

about.h1: A school with a century of trust behind it
about.lead: Founded in Panchgani in 1920 and part of Anjuman-I-Islam, which has served education since 1874.

academics.h1: Marks that matter, and minds that keep asking why
academics.lead: Advisors who know your child’s goals, peer tutors in the dorm, labs that reward curiosity, and entrance coaching on the same campus.

life.h1: Where friendships, faith and talent grow together
life.lead: Sport, art, robotics, riding and prayer shape the rounded person your child becomes, across 174 acres.

admissions.lead: Five clear steps, honest conversations and a team that guides you from the first call to the first day.
